top_signals.title: Gold Edges Higher as Lower Oil Prices Damp Chance of Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Gold edged higher as a slump in oil prices over the past few sessions reduced the chance of further interest-rate hikes by the Federal Reserve to contain inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
